business_summary.text: Modis Navnirman is a real estate development company engaged in residential and commercial construction and redevelopment.

call_points.text: Management expects margins to bounce back to previous levels in FY27 after temporary Q4 moderation.
Ongoing construction of 12.5 lakh sq. ft. across 24 projects provides strong revenue visibility.
Realizations for Square project targeted at ₹27,000-28,000 per sq. ft. as it nears completion.
Raw material inflation impacted Square and Signature projects, but impact is lower for other projects.
Migration to Main Board and merger of private entity into listed entity completed in FY26.
Supply side is high in Mumbai, but company relies on amenities to differentiate and drive demand.
Board is currently prioritizing project execution over dividend payments.

operating_notes.text: Migrated from SME Platform to Main Board of Stock Exchanges with effect from November 14, 2025.
Wholly owned subsidiary Modi's Navnirman Foundation incorporated under section 8 on January 20, 2026.
Area sold grew 23% year-on-year to 53,000 sq. ft. in FY26.
Average selling price base is ₹25,000-27,000 per sq. ft.
Total project portfolio of 7.5 lakh sq. ft. has 4.92 lakh sq. ft. booked and 2.40 lakh sq. ft. available inventory.
Acquired two new projects, Rashmi Shetal and Rashmi Gold, in the first financial year.
Secured redevelopment mandate for Neel Kiran CHSL in Khar West with ₹250 Cr GDV potential.
H1FY27 cost of materials and goods stood at 76.6% of revenue.
Effective tax rate for H1FY27 was 23.2%.
H1 FY27 sales volume reached 78,560 sq. ft. generating sales value of ₹202 Cr.
Total development pipeline stands at 28.83 lakh sq. ft., with 12.11 lakh sq. ft. ongoing and 10.50 lakh sq. ft. upcoming launches.
Ongoing projects carry total revenue potential of ₹661 Cr, comprising ₹156 Cr from committed sales and ₹505 Cr from unsold units.
